# Recording status: H1 and H2 in condition U for all three models (sensitivity; generated by analyze_recording.py)

Plan: `docs/analysis_plan_recording_status.md`, "Sensitivity: H1 and H2 in condition U" (fixed 2026-11-03 before the run). Pull: `pull_B_k10` of `embeddings/results/nnpm_<model>.csv` for the three models; the main analysis used the earlier pipeline's `pull_index` for OpenAI and the same condition-U pulls for bge-m3 and gemini. Items, labels, tests and decision rules as in `results/recording_results.md`.

OpenAI `pull_index` against condition U: 0 of 213 values identical; largest absolute difference 0.386.

| hypothesis | labels | main analysis | condition U |
|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | majority | not supported (0/3) | not supported (0/3) |
| H2 | majority | not supported (0/3 Holm) | supported (2/3 Holm) |
| H1 | unanimous | not supported (0/3) | not supported (0/3) |
| H2 | unanimous | mixed (1/3 Holm) | supported (2/3 Holm) |

Verdict changes: H2 (majority labels): not supported -> supported; H2 (unanimous): mixed -> supported.
